_comment: SHA-256 of the artifacts `npm run compile` produces with the pinned circom version in circuits/config.json. Deterministic: given the same circom, membership.template.circom, config.json and poseidon-bls12381-circom, these three files reproduce byte-for-byte. Regenerate with `cd circuits && npm run compile && node scripts/compute-artifact-hashes.mjs` and commit both this file and the .sha256 files together. The zkey is deliberately absent — it is non-deterministic (fresh /dev/urandom ceremony entropy), so it is verified by setup.sh/verify-setup.sh against the committed verification_key.json instead.
